item.title: A strong run ends just short of the final, but Greece keeps medal hopes alive at the 2026 Men's European Water Polo Championship in Belgrade.
item.description: Greece's men's water polo team fell 12-15 to Hungary in the semifinal of the 2026 European Water Polo Championships in Belgrade on January 23, ending their unbeaten run but keeping medal hopes alive. The Greeks built an early lead with strong attacking play in the first two quarters, but Hungary mounted a decisive comeback from the third period to secure victory and a spot in Sunday's final against Serbia.
